'''Csaplar''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Csilla/Legends|Csilla]] and the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]].<ref name="TEA" /> Csaplar was the center of the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] government, containing [[House Palace]], the parliament, the headquarters for the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]], and the four ruling families.<ref name="Game 5" />

Csaplar was connected to every location of Csilla through an underground system of tubes.<ref name="TEA" />
